correctness.rationale: For every Latin square of order n>=5, the union Y of full row/column/symbol line simplices has an equivariant nerve whose colored 2-faces are precisely incident triples. Attaching the missing rainbow triangles obtains the triple join R*C*S, with integral reduced H2 the three augmentation tensor lattices. Every other mixed maximal clique is an intercalate tetrahedron, whose four rainbow facets assemble the octahedral sphere (e_r0-e_r1)⊗(e_c0-e_c1)⊗(e_s0-e_s1). Each rainbow triangle lies in at most one such tetrahedron, so a coefficient on a designated facet provides an integral abelian-group left inverse: injection is primitive and H3 vanishes, not just rational. The dihedral/row-column swaps of the four vertices of an intercalate induce even permutations, yielding untwisted permutation action on the intercalate domain. Taking traces gives product of fixed-line counts minus fixed intercalates. Source verify.py inspected for independent signed Lefschetz tests on cyclic groups of orders 4–6, V4 and a nongroup order-five table. Infinite n conclusion follows from the nerve/relative proof, not those finite checks.
